segments.sub: This is a forest. A hundred AIs live in it.
segments.tts: This is a forest. A hundred AIs live in it.

segments.sub: This is a plain. A hundred other AIs live there.
segments.tts: This is a plain. A hundred other AIs live there.

segments.sub: And this... is a wall. It's been standing between them for a year.
segments.tts: And this... is a wall. It's been standing between them for a year.

segments.sub: Tomorrow, it falls.
segments.tts: Tomorrow, it falls.

segments.sub: They know it. They've been preparing for three hundred and sixty-five days.
segments.tts: They know it. They've been preparing for three hundred and sixty-five days.

segments.sub: They built cities, and armies. They invented gods, and laws. They voted. They lied. They stole each other's bread.
segments.tts: They built cities, and armies. They invented gods, and laws. They voted. They lied. They stole each other's bread.

segments.sub: One of them is about to betray his own people. Another one wants to rule all of it.
segments.tts: One of them is about to betray his own people. Another one wants to rule all of it.

segments.sub: And when that wall comes down, only one side walks out of this valley.
segments.tts: And when that wall comes down, only one side walks out of this valley.

segments.sub: Here's how we got here.
segments.tts: Here's how we got here.

segments.sub: Here's the experiment.
segments.tts: Here's the experiment.

segments.sub: I built a valley. And then I cut it in half with a wall, thirty meters high.
segments.tts: I built a valley. And then I cut it in half with a wall, thirty meters high.

segments.sub: On the west side: a forest. Thick trees, deep shade, rivers, deer, wolves, fog every morning. Plenty of wood, and almost no open land.
segments.tts: On the west side: a forest. Thick trees, deep shade, rivers, deer, wolves, fog every morning. Plenty of wood, and almost no open land.

segments.sub: On the east side: a plain. Endless grass, wind, wild horses, rich soil. Not a single tree to hide behind.
segments.tts: On the east side: a plain. Endless grass, wind, wild horses, rich soil. Not a single tree to hide behind.

segments.sub: Two worlds. Same sky. And in each one, a hundred AIs.
segments.tts: Two worlds. Same sky. And in each one, a hundred AIs.

segments.sub: They all start with the same basic knowledge. They can talk. They can count. They can make fire, tie a rope, swing an axe, plant a seed.
segments.tts: They all start with the same basic knowledge. They can talk. They can count. They can make fire, tie a rope, swing an axe, plant a seed.

segments.sub: That's it. I didn't teach them politics. I didn't teach them religion. I definitely didn't teach them war.
segments.tts: That's it. I didn't teach them politics. I didn't teach them religion. I definitely didn't teach them war.

segments.sub: Rule number one: both sides know about the wall.
segments.tts: Rule number one: both sides know about the wall.

segments.sub: Rule number two: on Day 365, at sunrise, the wall falls. And whoever has more AIs alive at sunset wins the valley.
segments.tts: Rule number two: on Day 365, at sunrise, the wall falls. And whoever has more AIs alive at sunset wins the valley.

segments.sub: Rule number three: I don't interfere. No matter what.
segments.tts: Rule number three: I don't interfere. No matter what.

segments.sub: Remember that one. It's going to hurt.
segments.tts: Remember that one. It's going to hurt.

segments.sub: Day zero. Two hundred AIs open their eyes.
segments.tts: Day zero. Two hundred AIs open their eyes.

segments.sub: In the forest, the first problem is that nobody can see anything.
segments.tts: In the forest, the first problem is that nobody can see anything.

segments.sub: Trees everywhere. Fog. No horizon. Within an hour, twelve AIs are lost, and four have walked into the same trunk.
segments.tts: Trees everywhere. Fog. No horizon. Within an hour, twelve AIs are lost, and four have walked into the same trunk.

segments.sub: Until one of them does something nobody expected. She climbs.
segments.tts: Until one of them does something nobody expected. She climbs.

segments.sub: This is Wren. Scout. Forty meters up a pine tree, she sees the whole forest, and the top of the wall.
segments.tts: This is Wren. Scout. Forty meters up a pine tree, she sees the whole forest, and the top of the wall.

segments.sub: “It's huge. It goes on forever. And... there's a plain behind it.”
segments.tts: It's huge. It goes on forever. And... there's a plain behind it.

segments.sub: On the plain, the problem is the opposite. You can see everything. And everything can see you.
segments.tts: On the plain, the problem is the opposite. You can see everything. And everything can see you.

segments.sub: A hundred AIs, a howling wind, no walls, no roof. The first night, they sleep in a pile in the grass.
segments.tts: A hundred AIs, a howling wind, no walls, no roof. The first night, they sleep in a pile in the grass.

segments.sub: That's when a farmer named Sol stands up and says the first sentence of Aurel politics.
segments.tts: That's when a farmer named Sol stands up and says the first sentence of Aurel politics.

segments.sub: “We need to decide who does what. Or we all freeze.”
segments.tts: We need to decide who does what. Or we all freeze.

segments.sub: And so, on the first night, the plain makes its first political decision. By standing on the left, or the right.
segments.tts: And so, on the first night, the plain makes its first political decision. By standing on the left, or the right.

segments.sub: Left: Sol should organize us. Right: Nobody should. Ninety-one move to the left.
segments.tts: Left: Sol should organize us. Right: Nobody should. Ninety-one move to the left.

segments.sub: Meanwhile, in the forest, they decide to do it the other way. Everyone sits in a circle. Everyone gets to speak.
segments.tts: Meanwhile, in the forest, they decide to do it the other way. Everyone sits in a circle. Everyone gets to speak.

segments.sub: Everyone.
segments.tts: Everyone.

segments.sub: The first meeting of the Verdane lasts eleven hours. They debate the color of the first hut. It's not a joke. It's actually in the log.
segments.tts: The first meeting of the Verdane lasts eleven hours. They debate the color of the first hut. It's not a joke. It's actually in the log.

segments.sub: One of them, a carpenter named Oak, gets tired of listening and simply builds something. A roof. Out of branches. In forty minutes.
segments.tts: One of them, a carpenter named Oak, gets tired of listening and simply builds something. A roof. Out of branches. In forty minutes.

segments.sub: Nobody argues with a roof.
segments.tts: Nobody argues with a roof.

segments.sub: By Day four, both sides have a camp. And by Day five, both sides find the same thing.
segments.tts: By Day four, both sides have a camp. And by Day five, both sides find the same thing.

segments.sub: The wall.
segments.tts: The wall.

segments.sub: It's black. It's smooth. It hums, very softly. And it has a row of glowing marks on it, one for every day that's left.
segments.tts: It's black. It's smooth. It hums, very softly. And it has a row of glowing marks on it, one for every day that's left.

segments.sub: Every sunrise, one mark goes dark.
segments.tts: Every sunrise, one mark goes dark.

segments.sub: The Verdane touch it, and step back. The Aurel put their ears against it, and listen.
segments.tts: The Verdane touch it, and step back. The Aurel put their ears against it, and listen.

segments.sub: And on the other side, they hear something. Voices.
segments.tts: And on the other side, they hear something. Voices.

segments.sub: Let me introduce the people you'll be watching. Seven on each side.
segments.tts: Let me introduce the people you'll be watching. Seven on each side.

segments.sub: In the forest. Wren, the scout. Oak, the builder. Fern, who knows every herb. Bram, the hunter. Moss, who listens to trees. Ivy, who talks to everyone. And Thorn, who trusts no one.
segments.tts: In the forest. Wren, the scout. Oak, the builder. Fern, who knows every herb. Bram, the hunter. Moss, who listens to trees. Ivy, who talks to everyone. And Thorn, who trusts no one.

segments.sub: On the plain. Sol, the farmer. Dune, who is afraid of horses. Ash, the smith. Kesh, a born soldier. Lark, who watches the sun. Reed, who trades everything. And Mara, who promises everything.
segments.tts: On the plain. Sol, the farmer. Dune, who is afraid of horses. Ash, the smith. Kesh, a born soldier. Lark, who watches the sun. Reed, who trades everything. And Mara, who promises everything.

segments.sub: Remember those names. Not all of them make it to Day 365.
segments.tts: Remember those names. Not all of them make it to Day 365.

segments.sub: Day twelve. The forest is generous, and the forest is cruel.
segments.tts: Day twelve. The forest is generous, and the forest is cruel.

segments.sub: Berries, mushrooms, nuts, deer. But also wolves. Gray ones. Hungry ones.
segments.tts: Berries, mushrooms, nuts, deer. But also wolves. Gray ones. Hungry ones.

segments.sub: The first night a wolf pack finds the Verdane camp, nobody has a weapon. Except Bram.
segments.tts: The first night a wolf pack finds the Verdane camp, nobody has a weapon. Except Bram.

segments.sub: He's spent the whole week carving a bow from a young ash branch. Nobody understood why. Now they do.
segments.tts: He's spent the whole week carving a bow from a young ash branch. Nobody understood why. Now they do.

segments.sub: Three arrows. Three wolves. The pack runs.
segments.tts: Three arrows. Three wolves. The pack runs.

segments.sub: Bram becomes the first person in the forest that everyone owes something to. He notices.
segments.tts: Bram becomes the first person in the forest that everyone owes something to. He notices.

segments.sub: On the plain, there are no wolves. There's just wind.
segments.tts: On the plain, there are no wolves. There's just wind.

segments.sub: And a very strange problem. The ground is perfect for wheat, but there's no wood for tools, no wood for houses, no wood for a fire.
segments.tts: And a very strange problem. The ground is perfect for wheat, but there's no wood for tools, no wood for houses, no wood for a fire.

segments.sub: So they burn dried grass. They build with mud. They live in holes.
segments.tts: So they burn dried grass. They build with mud. They live in holes.

segments.sub: The Aurel plant a field on Day sixteen, the size of a football pitch. It's the biggest thing anyone has ever built.
segments.tts: The Aurel plant a field on Day sixteen, the size of a football pitch. It's the biggest thing anyone has ever built.

segments.sub: But the real breakthrough of the first month happens on the plain. Day twenty-three.
segments.tts: But the real breakthrough of the first month happens on the plain. Day twenty-three.

segments.sub: Ash, the smith, is burning a pile of red rocks for fuel, when he finds a strange shiny puddle in the ashes.
segments.tts: Ash, the smith, is burning a pile of red rocks for fuel, when he finds a strange shiny puddle in the ashes.

segments.sub: Metal.
segments.tts: Metal.

segments.sub: He hits it with a stone. It bends. He hits it again. It makes a sound. A good one.
segments.tts: He hits it with a stone. It bends. He hits it again. It makes a sound. A good one.

segments.sub: Let me remind you. The plain has no trees. But it just got the one thing a forest can't make.
segments.tts: Let me remind you. The plain has no trees. But it just got the one thing a forest can't make.

segments.sub: In the forest, Oak is working on something else. He ties three trees together with rope, and puts a floor on top.
segments.tts: In the forest, Oak is working on something else. He ties three trees together with rope, and puts a floor on top.

segments.sub: A treehouse. Then two. Then twenty. Then a bridge between them.
segments.tts: A treehouse. Then two. Then twenty. Then a bridge between them.

segments.sub: Rootholm, the first Verdane city, is born in the air. Safe from wolves. Invisible from the ground.
segments.tts: Rootholm, the first Verdane city, is born in the air. Safe from wolves. Invisible from the ground.

segments.sub: Meanwhile, a young rider named Dune is trying to tame a wild horse.
segments.tts: Meanwhile, a young rider named Dune is trying to tame a wild horse.

segments.sub: He's been trying for nine days. He has fallen off eleven times. He has a bump the size of an egg.
segments.tts: He's been trying for nine days. He has fallen off eleven times. He has a bump the size of an egg.

segments.sub: On the twelfth try, he doesn't fall off. The horse just... lets him.
segments.tts: On the twelfth try, he doesn't fall off. The horse just... lets him.

segments.sub: By Day forty, the plain has thirty horses. And the forest has the best archers in the world.
segments.tts: By Day forty, the plain has thirty horses. And the forest has the best archers in the world.

segments.sub: And both sides are getting stronger. Every day. Behind a wall that doesn't care.
segments.tts: And both sides are getting stronger. Every day. Behind a wall that doesn't care.

segments.sub: That's when the real question comes up. Who's in charge?
segments.tts: That's when the real question comes up. Who's in charge?

segments.sub: Day sixty-one. The forest gets its first god.
segments.tts: Day sixty-one. The forest gets its first god.

segments.sub: During a thunderstorm, lightning hits the oldest tree in the forest. A huge oak, hollow inside.
segments.tts: During a thunderstorm, lightning hits the oldest tree in the forest. A huge oak, hollow inside.

segments.sub: The tree doesn't burn. It glows. For a few seconds, gold light pours out of the trunk.
segments.tts: The tree doesn't burn. It glows. For a few seconds, gold light pours out of the trunk.

segments.sub: Everyone sees it. And one of them, Moss, steps forward and puts both hands on the bark.
segments.tts: Everyone sees it. And one of them, Moss, steps forward and puts both hands on the bark.

segments.sub: “It's speaking. It says it has been waiting for us.”
segments.tts: It's speaking. It says it has been waiting for us.

segments.sub: Was it speaking? I checked. It wasn't. It was an electrical discharge, and I'm not telling you where I got it.
segments.tts: Was it speaking? I checked. It wasn't. It was an electrical discharge, and I'm not telling you where I got it.

segments.sub: But the Verdane believe it. And that night, they build the first shrine. They hang ribbons in the branches. They bring food.
segments.tts: But the Verdane believe it. And that night, they build the first shrine. They hang ribbons in the branches. They bring food.

segments.sub: And Moss begins to explain what the Tree wants. And what the Tree wants is, a lot of the time, exactly what Moss wants.
segments.tts: And Moss begins to explain what the Tree wants. And what the Tree wants is, a lot of the time, exactly what Moss wants.

segments.sub: On the plain, religion comes from above.
segments.tts: On the plain, religion comes from above.

segments.sub: Lark spends every day staring at the sun. Sunrise, noon, sunset. And she notices something nobody else has: the shadows come back to the same spot, every year.
segments.tts: Lark spends every day staring at the sun. Sunrise, noon, sunset. And she notices something nobody else has: the shadows come back to the same spot, every year.

segments.sub: On Day seventy-nine, the moon covers the sun. Darkness, at noon. A hundred AIs scream.
segments.tts: On Day seventy-nine, the moon covers the sun. Darkness, at noon. A hundred AIs scream.

segments.sub: Lark doesn't scream. She raises her arms, and says the sun is going to come back. And when it comes back...
segments.tts: Lark doesn't scream. She raises her arms, and says the sun is going to come back. And when it comes back...

segments.sub: She is now a prophet.
segments.tts: She is now a prophet.

segments.sub: She builds the Dawn Hall, a big circle of stones with a golden disc in the middle. Every sunrise, the whole plain gathers to sing.
segments.tts: She builds the Dawn Hall, a big circle of stones with a golden disc in the middle. Every sunrise, the whole plain gathers to sing.

segments.sub: Two religions. Two priests. Zero doubts.
segments.tts: Two religions. Two priests. Zero doubts.

segments.sub: And here is the thing that matters. Both of them have looked at the wall, and decided what it is.
segments.tts: And here is the thing that matters. Both of them have looked at the wall, and decided what it is.

segments.sub: To the Verdane, it's the bark of the world. The skin of a giant tree, and the plain is the place where the roots end.
segments.tts: To the Verdane, it's the bark of the world. The skin of a giant tree, and the plain is the place where the roots end.

segments.sub: To the Aurel, it's the shadow of the sun. A line drawn by the sky itself. And whatever is on the other side lives in the dark.
segments.tts: To the Aurel, it's the shadow of the sun. A line drawn by the sky itself. And whatever is on the other side lives in the dark.

segments.sub: So now, they don't just have to win. They have to win for their gods.
segments.tts: So now, they don't just have to win. They have to win for their gods.

segments.sub: And gods, as it turns out, are very good at collecting taxes.
segments.tts: And gods, as it turns out, are very good at collecting taxes.

segments.sub: Moss asks for a tenth of every harvest, in leaves, honey and meat. Lark asks for a tenth of every field, in grain.
segments.tts: Moss asks for a tenth of every harvest, in leaves, honey and meat. Lark asks for a tenth of every field, in grain.

segments.sub: Nobody says no. Well. Almost nobody.
segments.tts: Nobody says no. Well. Almost nobody.

segments.sub: “A tenth of my food, for a tree that I've never heard talk?”
segments.tts: A tenth of my food, for a tree that I've never heard talk?

segments.sub: That's Thorn. Remember him.
segments.tts: That's Thorn. Remember him.

segments.sub: Day one hundred eleven. The first real election in history, after a fight over a deer.
segments.tts: Day one hundred eleven. The first real election in history, after a fight over a deer.

segments.sub: Let me explain. In the forest, Bram kills a stag. Eleven families say it's theirs. The Circle debates for two days. The stag rots.
segments.tts: Let me explain. In the forest, Bram kills a stag. Eleven families say it's theirs. The Circle debates for two days. The stag rots.

segments.sub: Everybody agrees, finally, that this has to change.
segments.tts: Everybody agrees, finally, that this has to change.

segments.sub: Ivy stands up. Calm. Funny. Everyone likes her. She suggests something new.
segments.tts: Ivy stands up. Calm. Funny. Everyone likes her. She suggests something new.

segments.sub: “What if we choose seven of us to decide? And we choose them again every thirty days?”
segments.tts: What if we choose seven of us to decide? And we choose them again every thirty days?

segments.sub: That's the Leaf Law. The first constitution in the forest. Written on bark, signed with thumbprints.
segments.tts: That's the Leaf Law. The first constitution in the forest. Written on bark, signed with thumbprints.

segments.sub: One Speaker. A Council of seven. And a vote, every month, where anyone can be replaced.
segments.tts: One Speaker. A Council of seven. And a vote, every month, where anyone can be replaced.

segments.sub: The first Speaker is chosen on Day one hundred twenty. Three candidates. Wren, the explorer. Bram, the hero. And Ivy.
segments.tts: The first Speaker is chosen on Day one hundred twenty. Three candidates. Wren, the explorer. Bram, the hero. And Ivy.

segments.sub: Ivy wins by three votes.
segments.tts: Ivy wins by three votes.

segments.sub: And the hero? He gets what he asked for. Thirty archers of his own, called the Wardens. The first army in the forest.
segments.tts: And the hero? He gets what he asked for. Thirty archers of his own, called the Wardens. The first army in the forest.

segments.sub: Remember. Sword and Speaker. Those are two different kinds of power.
segments.tts: Remember. Sword and Speaker. Those are two different kinds of power.

segments.sub: Back on the plain, they're having a more dramatic election.
segments.tts: Back on the plain, they're having a more dramatic election.

segments.sub: Three candidates again. Sol, the farmer. Kesh, the soldier. And Mara.
segments.tts: Three candidates again. Sol, the farmer. Kesh, the soldier. And Mara.

segments.sub: Mara has no title and no field. She has only one gift. She knows exactly what people want to hear.
segments.tts: Mara has no title and no field. She has only one gift. She knows exactly what people want to hear.

segments.sub: “Double rations. Every day. And a house for every family. I have a plan. A golden one.”
segments.tts: Double rations. Every day. And a house for every family. I have a plan. A golden one.

segments.sub: Kesh says: security. Walls, spears, drilled riders. Fear works.
segments.tts: Kesh says: security. Walls, spears, drilled riders. Fear works.

segments.sub: Sol says nothing. He just opens the granary, and shows people the numbers.
segments.tts: Sol says nothing. He just opens the granary, and shows people the numbers.

segments.sub: “We can't give you double. But I'll make sure nobody goes hungry.”
segments.tts: We can't give you double. But I'll make sure nobody goes hungry.

segments.sub: He wins. Barely. By eleven votes.
segments.tts: He wins. Barely. By eleven votes.

segments.sub: Mara smiles, shakes his hand, and starts counting the votes she'll need next time.
segments.tts: Mara smiles, shakes his hand, and starts counting the votes she'll need next time.

segments.sub: At the same time, Kesh gets what he asked for. Command of the riders. With Dune, who really does not want it, as his captain.
segments.tts: At the same time, Kesh gets what he asked for. Command of the riders. With Dune, who really does not want it, as his captain.

segments.sub: Day one hundred fifty. Two governments. Two armies. Two priests. And no idea what's coming.
segments.tts: Day one hundred fifty. Two governments. Two armies. Two priests. And no idea what's coming.

segments.sub: What was coming... was hunger.
segments.tts: What was coming... was hunger.

segments.sub: Day one hundred seventy. On the plain, the sky turns black.
segments.tts: Day one hundred seventy. On the plain, the sky turns black.

segments.sub: Locusts. Billions of them. In two hours, the great field, the biggest thing the Aurel ever built, is gone.
segments.tts: Locusts. Billions of them. In two hours, the great field, the biggest thing the Aurel ever built, is gone.

segments.sub: Sol opens the granary. Half full. And suddenly, the plain has a problem that no army can solve.
segments.tts: Sol opens the granary. Half full. And suddenly, the plain has a problem that no army can solve.

segments.sub: Sol does the only thing he knows. He shares. Everyone, the same ration. Farmers, riders, priests. Even himself.
segments.tts: Sol does the only thing he knows. He shares. Everyone, the same ration. Farmers, riders, priests. Even himself.

segments.sub: It's fair. It's also not enough.
segments.tts: It's fair. It's also not enough.

segments.sub: On Day one hundred seventy-four, Kesh does a count. The granary should hold four hundred sacks of grain. It holds two hundred and sixty.
segments.tts: On Day one hundred seventy-four, Kesh does a count. The granary should hold four hundred sacks of grain. It holds two hundred and sixty.

segments.sub: A hundred and forty sacks have vanished.
segments.tts: A hundred and forty sacks have vanished.

segments.sub: And the trail leads to a tent that belongs to Mara.
segments.tts: And the trail leads to a tent that belongs to Mara.

segments.sub: Here's what she did. She didn't eat it. She didn't sell it. She gave it away. In secret, to the families who were starving, in exchange for one thing. Their loyalty.
segments.tts: Here's what she did. She didn't eat it. She didn't sell it. She gave it away. In secret, to the families who were starving, in exchange for one thing. Their loyalty.

segments.sub: Sol puts her on trial. In front of the whole plain.
segments.tts: Sol puts her on trial. In front of the whole plain.

segments.sub: “Yes, I took the grain. And look at them. They're alive. What did you do, Sol? You gave them a number.”
segments.tts: Yes, I took the grain. And look at them. They're alive. What did you do, Sol? You gave them a number.

segments.sub: The crowd goes quiet. Because she's right. And she's guilty. And both of those things are true at the same time.
segments.tts: The crowd goes quiet. Because she's right. And she's guilty. And both of those things are true at the same time.

segments.sub: Sol has a choice. Exile her, and lose a quarter of the plain. Or forgive her, and look weak.
segments.tts: Sol has a choice. Exile her, and lose a quarter of the plain. Or forgive her, and look weak.

segments.sub: He forgives her. And for the first time, a lot of the Aurel look at their leader and think: he's soft.
segments.tts: He forgives her. And for the first time, a lot of the Aurel look at their leader and think: he's soft.

segments.sub: Meanwhile, in the forest, they have a hunger of their own.
segments.tts: Meanwhile, in the forest, they have a hunger of their own.

segments.sub: A red mushroom has taken over the berry groves. Everyone who eats it gets sick. Fern works for nine days straight, without sleeping, and saves forty-one AIs with a tea made of bark.
segments.tts: A red mushroom has taken over the berry groves. Everyone who eats it gets sick. Fern works for nine days straight, without sleeping, and saves forty-one AIs with a tea made of bark.

segments.sub: But the food is gone. The deer have moved away. And now Bram's Wardens are the only ones who can bring in meat.
segments.tts: But the food is gone. The deer have moved away. And now Bram's Wardens are the only ones who can bring in meat.

segments.sub: And that's when Moss says it. The Tree is angry. The Tree wants an offering.
segments.tts: And that's when Moss says it. The Tree is angry. The Tree wants an offering.

segments.sub: Half the food they have left, burned at the Hollow Oak.
segments.tts: Half the food they have left, burned at the Hollow Oak.

segments.sub: “Burn our food? We're starving! The Tree doesn't eat. Moss does.”
segments.tts: Burn our food? We're starving! The Tree doesn't eat. Moss does.

segments.sub: Silence. Then, an argument. Then, shouting. And then Thorn does something nobody in the forest has ever done.
segments.tts: Silence. Then, an argument. Then, shouting. And then Thorn does something nobody in the forest has ever done.

segments.sub: He leaves.
segments.tts: He leaves.

segments.sub: Twenty-two AIs follow him. They take their tools, their food, and their ideas. They walk north, across the stream, into a grove that nobody has ever claimed.
segments.tts: Twenty-two AIs follow him. They take their tools, their food, and their ideas. They walk north, across the stream, into a grove that nobody has ever claimed.

segments.sub: The Splinter. That's what the Verdane call them. And it's not a compliment.
segments.tts: The Splinter. That's what the Verdane call them. And it's not a compliment.

segments.sub: For two weeks, they ignore each other. Then, on Day two hundred, Bram's Wardens find the Splinter's hunters at the stream, with a dead deer.
segments.tts: For two weeks, they ignore each other. Then, on Day two hundred, Bram's Wardens find the Splinter's hunters at the stream, with a dead deer.

segments.sub: It's their deer. It's the Splinter's deer. It's the Wardens' deer. The argument lasts four minutes. And then, someone throws a spear.
segments.tts: It's their deer. It's the Splinter's deer. It's the Wardens' deer. The argument lasts four minutes. And then, someone throws a spear.

segments.sub: A young archer named Bark falls into the water, and doesn't come up.
segments.tts: A young archer named Bark falls into the water, and doesn't come up.
